text.p: 360 Communicatons Co said Monday it and BellSouth Corp completed a deal to combine cellular partnerships that the two companies had jointly owned into a single partnership.
The agreement involves cellular operations in Richmond, Va., and Orlando, Fla.
360 has agreed to contribute an undisclosed amount of cash to the newly formed partnership, which will be owned 75 percent by BellSouth and 25 percent by 360.
Under terms of the deal, 360 assumed management of the Richmond cellular market, which previously was managed by BellSouth under the Cellular One brand, 360 said.
BellSouth will continue to manage and operate the second cellular market, which includes Orlando and other parts of central Florida.
